description: This PHP file defines the 'UserPreferencesForm' class used for managing user preferences within the Goteo application. It constructs a form with options for communication language, currency, and boolean preferences, and includes functionality to save these preferences.

classes.name: UserPreferencesForm
classes.description: A form processor class for managing user preferences such as language, currency, and boolean settings within the Goteo application.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Stub method meant to return validation constraints for a form field.

methods.name: getLanguagesChoices
methods.description: Returns an array of language choices for the form, derived from the application's language list.

methods.name: getCurrenciesChoices
methods.description: Returns an array of currency choices based on the application's currency list.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Builds the user preferences form with fields for communication language, currency, and boolean preferences, and adds a submit button.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the form submission, validates data, saves user preferences, and provides user feedback messages.
